items.docs: Retrieves a list of storage virtual machines (SVMs) in the cluster. SVMs are secure virtualized storage containers that provide data access to clients. Each SVM has its own volumes, network interfaces, protocols, and security configuration.

Creates a new storage virtual machine (SVM). The SVM name is required. Optional parameters include allowed protocols (NFS, CIFS, iSCSI, FCP), aggregates, language, snapshot policy, and IP interface configuration.
